name: kinetic-marquee
title: Kinetic Marquee
description: A continuous text band whose speed responds to scroll velocity — faster scrolling accelerates the ticker and skews it proportionally, settling back to base speed when scrolling stops.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Condensed
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Scroll Velocity: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
